• Proven experience editing performance ads for DTC brands

• Experience in beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care is a strong plus

• Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising formats and what makes ads convert

• Experience using AI-generated content and AI creative tools

• Ability to understand a creative brief and independently translate strategy into compelling visuals

• Strong attention to detail in pacing, storytelling, shot selection, visual logic, and overall ad quality

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with frequent creative iterations



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your portfolio link and CV

2. Have you worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands? If so, please specify the brand names and specify your role and length of experience.

4. Your current availability/start date

5. Your expected monthly salary

6. A short note on the editing tools and AI tools you use

7. From a clear brief and provided raw footage, how many finished 30–60 second ad can you normally produce in one day?

8. For a 1-minute video, how long does it usually take you to re-edit the video after receiving revision feedback?

9. How many years have you been a full-time video editor?

10. Which types of performance ad creatives are you strongest at editing, and which are you less confident with? Please list them separately (e.g., UGC, product demos, testimonials, storytelling ads, AI-generated creatives etc).

11. Are you currently working with any other clients or companies? Looking for fractional or full-time?



Applications that do not follow the requested format may not be considered.

title: Project Management VA
description:
Company: MHI Media

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: Design Team Lead



About Us

MHI Media is a performance marketing agency that helps DTC brands scale to 7 and 8 figures. We manage creative production and paid media across Meta, TikTok, Google, and more — producing hundreds of ad creatives every month for 30+ active clients. Our design team of 25+ editors and designers operates at high volume and high speed.



The Role

We're looking for a proactive, highly organised Virtual Assistant to support the Design Team Lead in running day-to-day operations across a fast-moving creative team. You'll sit at the intersection of project management, content operations, and team coordination — making sure nothing slips through the cracks.



This isn't a passive "wait for instructions" role. You'll be managing workflows, tracking deliverables, coordinating across team members, and helping build systems that make the team faster and more efficient. If you have a creative or video editing background, even better — you'll understand the work at a deeper level.



What You'll Do

Operations & Project Management

- Manage and track daily task pipelines across the design team (Airtable, Slack, project boards)

- Monitor project statuses, flag blockers, and chase deadlines before they're missed

- Coordinate task assignments and workload distribution across designers and editors

- Prepare weekly output summaries, performance snapshots, and status reports



Workflow & Systems

- Set up and maintain operational workflows and automations (Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace)

- Document SOPs and processes so the team runs smoothly without micromanagement

- Identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements — we want someone who thinks in systems



Content & Asset Management

- Organise and maintain creative asset libraries (videos, images, templates)

- Ensure files are properly named, tagged, and accessible for the team

- Help manage content calendars and delivery schedules



Recruitment & Admin Support

- Draft and post job listings for creative roles (designers, editors, motion artists)

- Screen initial applications and coordinate interview scheduling

- Handle general admin tasks — inbox management, meeting prep, calendar coordination



What We're Looking For

Must-Haves:

- 2+ years experience in a VA, project management, or operations role

- Highly organised with strong attention to detail — you don't let things fall through the cracks

- Comfortable with tools like Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace, and project management platforms

- Excellent written communication — you'll be coordinating across a distributed team daily

- Self-starter who takes initiative without needing to be told what to do next

- Available during UK business hours.



Nice-to-Haves:

- Background in video editing, graphic design, or creative production

- Experience working in a creative agency or marketing team environment

- Familiarity with ad creative workflows (briefing ? production ? QA ? delivery)

- Experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make, or similar)

- Basic understanding of social media advertising (Meta, TikTok)



Why Join MHI Media?

- Work alongside a high-performing creative team producing content for brands scaling fast

- Fully remote — work from anywhere

- You'll have real impact — this role directly shapes how efficiently the team operates

- Growth opportunity — as the team scales, this role grows with it

title: Meta Ads Creative Specialist – AI UGC Video & Image Ads (Performance Marketing)
description:
We are a Sweden-based performance marketing company running lead generation across finance (credit cards, loans), energy and other consumer verticals. We are scaling our Meta Ads 
 & Instagram) and need a creative specialist who can produce winning ads at a high, steady pace.



The work focuses on two formats:

1. Hyper-realistic AI-generated UGC video ads (AI avatars/actors, talking-head testimonials, "real person" style content that feels native to the feed)

2. Static image ads



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Produce a continuous flow of AI UGC videos and image ads for Meta

- Write scripts, hooks, primary text and headlines, and create multiple variations of every concept for testing

- Make AI UGC look and sound natural: realistic avatars, lip sync, voice, pacing, captions, b-roll

- Research competitors daily (Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center etc.) and turn insights into new angles

- Analyze performance data with us, kill what doesn't work and iterate on what does

- Take initiative: pitch new concepts, angles and tools without waiting to be told



ABOUT THE MARKET

Most ads will target Sweden and be in Swedish. You do NOT need to speak Swedish. You will have access to LLM tools for translation and scripting, and we review all text before launch. You need to be comfortable producing AI voice and avatar content in a language you don't speak.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience creating AI UGC ads for direct-response / performance campaigns on Meta

- Hands-on experience with AI video and avatar tools (e.g. HeyGen, Arcads, Creatify, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield) and AI voice tools (e.g. ElevenLabs)

- Strong image ad skills: Canva, Figma, Photoshop and AI image tools (e.g. Midjourney, Flux)

- Video editing in CapCut, Premiere or similar

- A portfolio of ads you have made, ideally with results (CTR, CPA, ROAS or similar)

- Strong understanding of what makes an ad convert: hooks, angles, thumb-stopping visuals, offer framing

- Self-driven, fast and organized; able to deliver a high volume of creatives every week

- Good written English



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with financial products (credit cards, loans) or affiliate marketing

- Knowledge of Meta advertising policies, including rules for financial services and AI-generated content

- Experience with Nordic or European markets



WHAT WE OFFER

- Long-term, full-time remote position

- We pay for the AI tools you need

- Direct work with the founders, fast decisions, no bureaucracy

- Room to grow as our Meta channel scales



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. Links to 5–10 AI UGC videos and image ads you have created

2. A short description of your best-performing ad and why you think it worked

3. The AI tools you use daily for video, voice and images

4. Start your application with the words "Thumb-stopper" so we know you read the full post
salary: $6 / hour to start, could be increased

title: Marketing officer
description:

Part-time | 20 hours per week | AUD $8.00 per hour | Long-term | Immediate start

ABOUT US

Nationwide Migration & Education is an Australian migration agency based in Brisbane. We help skilled workers, employers, students and families with Australian and New Zealand visas. THE ROLE

 automations in GHL, help run our
/Instagram ads, and produce the content that keeps our social media, newsletters and blog moving every week.



This is a responsible role. Mistakes in a client-facing
, a broken funnel link or a typo in an ad are seen by thousands of people. Attention to detail is the number one thing we are hiring for.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



GoHighLevel (core of the role)

• Build and manage funnels, landing pages and lead forms

• Set up and maintain
 campaigns, nurture sequences and workflow automations (triggers, tags, pipelines, follow-up sequences)

• Manage pipelines and opportunities, keep contacts tagged and clean, assign leads to the right team member

• Set up and manage calendars and booking links so consultation slots are always available

Paid social

• Set up, monitor and optimise
/Instagram lead campaigns in Meta Ads Manager (Instant Forms, audiences, exclusions, creative testing)

Content and creative

• Design social media graphics and carousels in Canva (on brand, clean, correct spelling)

• Edit short reels (CapCut or similar): captions, cuts, hooks, music

• Schedule reels and posts across
, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube

• Draft and publish blog posts in GHL from briefs or video transcripts, with correct on-page SEO

• Repurpose one YouTube video into a blog, short-form reels and newsletter content

• Reply to social media comments and messages promptly and professionally

• Post client visa success outcomes



Admin and reporting

• Keep a simple weekly report of what was scheduled, sent, published and the results

• Join a weekly online marketing meeting with our Director (Brisbane time)



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU (non-negotiable)

• 2 to 3+ years of real digital marketing work experience for a business or agency (not just courses)

• Proven, hands-on GoHighLevel experience. You must have personally built funnels, workflows and
 campaigns in GHL for a real business. We will ask you to show this.

• Working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager (lead campaigns, Instant Forms, audiences)

• Confident in Canva and a reel-editing tool (CapCut, Premiere or similar)

• Excellent written English. You will write
s, captions and blogs that go to Australian clients.

• Outstanding attention to detail. You check links, spelling, dates, names and tags before anything goes out.

• Organised and self-managed. You can follow a content calendar and meet deadlines without reminders.

• Honest and reliable. If something breaks or you make a mistake, you tell us straight away.

• Able to work a consistent schedule that overlaps with Brisbane business hours (Brisbane is 2 hours ahead of Manila)

• Available to start immediately



NICE TO HAVE

• Experience with WordPress, Google Analytics (GA4) or Meta Pixel setup

• Experience with YouTube uploads, titles, thumbnails and descriptions

• Experience in a professional services, legal, education or migration business

• Comfortable using AI tools for drafting and editing (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS (we will check these)

• Stable internet: at least 25 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload

• A backup internet connection (mobile data / pocket WiFi) for when your main line drops

• A backup power plan for brownouts (UPS, generator, power bank, or a nearby co-working space). Power cuts are not an acceptable reason for missed deadlines.

• A reliable computer with at least 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred) that can run Canva and CapCut smoothly

• A quiet workspace with a working headset and webcam for weekly meetings



PAY AND HOURS

• AUD $8.00 per hour

• 20 hours per week (approximately AUD $160 per week / AUD $690 per month)

• Hours tracked via a time tracker and paid on a regular schedule to your preferred method

• Long-term role for the right person. Performance reviewed after a 30-day trial. Opportunity to grow hours and responsibilities as our marketing expands.



==========================================================

HOW TO APPLY – FOLLOW EVERY STEP

==========================================================



We get a lot of applications. To make sure we only speak to people who are detail-focused, you must complete ALL of the steps below. Any application missing a step will not be shortlisted.



STEP 1 – SUBJECT LINE

Your message subject line must be exactly:

PINEAPPLE – Digital Marketing Specialist – [Your Full Name]



Applications without the word PINEAPPLE in the subject line will be deleted unread.



STEP 2 – SHOW US YOUR GOHIGHLEVEL WORK

Attach or link screenshots of GoHighLevel work YOU built (blur any client names or private data):

a) A workflow/automation you built (show the trigger and the steps)

b) A funnel or landing page you built (link or screenshot)

c) An
 campaign or newsletter you sent from GHL, with its stats (open rate / click rate)

Then write 3 to 5 sentences explaining what that workflow did for the business and one problem you had to fix in GHL.



STEP 3 – SHOW US YOUR CREATIVE WORK

Attach or link:

a) 3 social media graphics you designed

b) 2 short reels you edited (Google Drive, Instagram or TikTok link)

c) 1 blog post or newsletter you wrote (link or PDF)

Tell us which tool you used for each.



STEP 4 – SHORT TASK (max 150 words)

A person downloads our free guide "How to Get Sponsored for an Australian Work Visa" through a
 Instant Form. Describe, step by step, the GHL workflow and 5
 nurture sequence you would set up to turn that lead into a booked consultation. Include the trigger, tags, timing between
s and the goal of each
.



STEP 5 – TECHNICAL SCREENSHOTS (all four are required)

a) A speed test from speedtest.net or fast.com showing download, upload and ping, taken today

b) Your computer specs showing processor, RAM and operating system (Windows: Settings > System > About. Mac: Apple menu > About This Mac)

c) Your backup internet (screenshot of your mobile data plan or a photo of your pocket WiFi)

d) Your backup power (photo of your UPS, generator or power bank, or the name of the co-working space you will use). If you do not have one, say so honestly and tell us your plan.



STEP 6 – ABOUT YOU

In your own words (no AI-generated paragraphs, we can tell):

• Years of digital marketing experience and the businesses or agencies you worked for

• How long you have used GoHighLevel and in what capacity

• Your current other commitments (other jobs, clients, study) and how many hours per week they take

• Your available hours in Brisbane time (AEST) and your earliest start date

• Your expected hourly rate (so we know you read the post)

• Attach your CV



STEP 7 – FINAL CHECK

Before you send, re-read your application once for spelling and broken links. Check that the subject line is exact. This is the job.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Shortlisted applicants will receive a reply within 3 to 5 business days and be invited to a short video interview, followed by a small paid test task in a GHL sandbox account before a final decision.



We look forward to seeing your work.

title: Excel Expert Needed to Create a Complete Wedding Planner Spreadsheet + English Video Tutorial
description:
Project Requirements

1. Create a Comprehensive Wedding Planner Excel Workbook



The workbook should cover everything someone would reasonably need to plan and organize a wedding, including but not limited to:



Wedding Dashboard: An overview of the wedding date, days remaining, planning progress, budget, and important tasks.

Wedding Budget Tracker: Estimated versus actual costs, deposits, balances due, payment deadlines, and budget summaries.

Guest List Manager: Guest names, contact details, RSVP status, meal preferences, dietary restrictions, plus-one information, and other useful notes.

Seating Chart Planner: A system to organize guests by table and manage seating arrangements.

Vendor Tracker: A place to manage venues, caterers, photographers, florists, DJs, officiants, and other vendors, including quotes, contracts, contact information, and payment schedules.

Wedding Checklist and Timeline: Tasks organized by timeframe, priority, status, and deadline, from the early planning stages through the wedding day.

Wedding Day Schedule: A detailed timeline covering preparations, ceremony, photographs, reception, speeches, entertainment, and other important events.

Venue and Vendor Comparison: Tools to compare options, prices, packages, and notes before making decisions.

Invitation and RSVP Tracker: Invitation status, send dates, responses, follow-ups, and guest attendance.

Attire and Beauty Planner: Wedding dress or suit, fittings, alterations, accessories, hair, makeup, and appointments.

Decorations and Flowers: Ideas, suppliers, costs, quantities, and purchasing checklists.

Menu and Catering Planner: Menu choices, dietary requirements, drinks, catering costs, and final guest counts.

Photography and Entertainment: Shot lists, music preferences, special requests, and entertainment arrangements.

Honeymoon and Travel Planner: Travel details, accommodation, transportation, and related costs.

Notes and Ideas: Space for inspiration, decisions, links, and miscellaneous wedding details.

These are suggested categories. I welcome your professional recommendations for additional tabs, features, or improvements that would make the workbook more useful.



2. Excel Functionality and Design

The spreadsheet must be more than a basic collection of tables. I want a polished, professional product with an attractive and consistent design.



Ideally, it should include:



A beautiful, cohesive visual design with professional formatting.

Easy navigation between worksheets.

Formulas that automatically calculate totals, remaining balances, budget differences, and completion percentages.

Drop-down menus, checkboxes where supported, and conditional formatting where appropriate.

Progress trackers and visual summaries.

Automatic updates to dashboard figures when information is entered or changed.

Clear instructions and examples to help first-time users understand what to enter.

Appropriate data validation and error prevention.

Compatibility with commonly used desktop versions of Microsoft Excel.

The workbook should be practical and intuitive for beginners while still taking advantage of Excel's capabilities. Please avoid unnecessary complexity or features that make it difficult to use.



3. Record a Video Tutorial in English

Once the spreadsheet is complete, you must record a clear and professional video tutorial explaining how to use it.



The video must:



Be presented in clear, understandable spoken English.

Include a screen recording showing the actual Excel workbook.

Walk through the workbook tab by tab and explain the purpose of each section.

Demonstrate how to enter information and use the main features, formulas, drop-downs, and trackers.

Explain how to update the budget, guest list, vendors, checklist, and dashboard.

Show how someone can use the spreadsheet throughout their wedding planning process.

Be well-paced, organized, and easy for a beginner to follow.

Have clear audio and a readable screen recording.

Be suitable for sharing with other people.

You must be comfortable recording yourself and speaking on camera, at least for an introduction or other relevant portions of the tutorial. I do not want someone who is only comfortable creating the spreadsheet but is unwilling to record a video or have their recording shared.



Important: The finished tutorial must be your own recording, and you must have the right to provide me with permission to share the video with others.



4. Deliverables

The successful freelancer will provide:



The completed Excel wedding planner workbook in editable .xlsx format.

A polished, fully functional spreadsheet with all agreed-upon features.

A recorded video tutorial explaining how to use the workbook.

The final video file in a commonly used format, such as MP4.

Any supporting instructions or a quick-start guide needed to help users get started.

A final review to check formulas, links, navigation, and functionality before delivery.

Ideal Candidate

You should have:



Advanced Excel skills and experience building complex, well-organized workbooks.

Experience with formulas, conditional formatting, data validation, dashboards, and automated calculations.

A strong eye for design and the ability to create visually appealing spreadsheets.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Confidence speaking on camera and recording a screen-sharing tutorial.

The ability to explain technical steps in a simple, beginner-friendly way.

Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.

The ability to deliver a polished, professional final product.

Experience creating planners, trackers, budgeting tools, project management templates, or wedding-related resources is a plus.



When Applying, Please Include

Examples of Excel workbooks or dashboards you have created, preferably with a polished design.

A brief description of your experience building automated Excel templates.

Confirmation that you are comfortable speaking English, recording yourself on camera, and creating a tutorial that will be shared with others.

A short sample of a screen-recorded tutorial you have made, if available.

Your proposed timeline and fixed-price quote for the entire project, including the workbook and video tutorial.

Any suggestions you have for making this wedding planner more comprehensive, attractive, and easy to use.

I am looking for someone who takes pride in their work and can create something genuinely useful, professional, and enjoyable to use.



Please apply only if you are confident you can deliver both the Excel workbook and the recorded English video tutorial.

title: Senior U.S. Human Resources Specialist – Part-Time, Remote
description:
About Utopia HR Solutions



Utopia HR Solutions is a growing U.S.-based human resources consulting firm providing customized HR support to small and midsize businesses across multiple industries and states.



Our services include HR audits, employee handbook development, policy creation, employee onboarding, compliance support, recruiting, performance management, and ongoing HR consulting.

- Research federal and state employment requirements using reliable government and regulatory sources.

- Prepare performance review templates, employee development documents, and other HR materials.

- Support recruiting activities, including resume screening, candidate tracking, and interview coordination.

- Organize client projects, maintain accurate documentation, and monitor deliverables and deadlines.

- Identify potential HR compliance concerns and escalate questions for review.

- Complete assigned work accurately, efficiently, and within agreed deadlines.



All client-facing compliance guidance and final HR deliverables are subject to review and approval by Utopia HR Solutions.



Required Qualifications



Applicants must have a minimum of six years of direct professional experience supporting U.S.-based human resources operations. This requirement is mandatory.



- At least 6 years of hands-on U.S. HR experience, including experience supporting American employers.

- Strong experience preparing U.S. employee handbooks, HR policies, job descriptions, and onboarding materials.

- Working knowledge of federal employment requirements, including FLSA, FMLA, ADA, and EEOC-related compliance.

- Experience supporting multistate U.S. employers.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience using HRIS platforms such as BambooHR, ADP, Paychex, or Rippling.

- Experience supporting small and midsize businesses across multiple industries.

- SHRM or HRCI certification is a plus.



Schedule and Working Arrangement



This is a long-term, part-time remote opportunity beginning at approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the potential for additional hours as business needs grow.



The selected professional will work directly with the founder of Utopia HR Solutions. Scheduling is flexible, provided deadlines are met and the individual is available for mutually agreed meetings.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to participate in a video interview and a compensated practical HR assessment.



Please note: Candidates who do not have at least six years of direct U.S. HR experience will not be considered.



We are looking for a knowledgeable, dependable HR professional interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with a growing U.S. consulting firm.

title: Senior Marketing Executive Assistant
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines)

Employment Type: Full-Time (40 Hours per Week)

Reports To: Director of Marketing Services



About Us

We are a fast-growing marketing department supporting multiple brands, product launches, partnerships, affiliates, podcasts, university internship programs, and digital marketing initiatives around the world.

Our team moves quickly, manages dozens of projects simultaneously, and values organization, communication, accountability, and continuous improvement.

We're looking for an exceptional Senior Marketing Executive Assistant who can become the operational hub of our Marketing Services department and help ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



About the Role

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

You'll work directly with the Director of Marketing Serivces to help keep our marketing department organized, on schedule, and operating efficiently. This role is focused on project coordination, organization, communication, and follow-through across a wide variety of marketing initiatives.

You'll help track priorities, organize information, coordinate with internal team members and external partners, and ensure leadership always has visibility into what needs attention.

If you enjoy bringing order to fast-paced environments and thrive on keeping people and projects organized, we'd love to meet you.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Executive Organization & Communication

Help manage executive priorities by organizing
s, tracking action items, monitoring deadlines, and ensuring important requests receive timely follow-up.

- Marketing Project Coordination

Maintain our marketing project tracker and help monitor the progress of ongoing initiatives across multiple teams, ensuring projects remain organized and on schedule.

- Project Management Support

Assist with organizing projects in Asana, maintaining timelines, assigning tasks, and helping teams stay aligned throughout each project.

- Podcast & Partnership Coordination

Help track podcast interviews, partnerships, affiliate requests, product shipments, and other marketing collaborations by monitoring communication and following up on outstanding items.

- University Internship Program

Support the coordination of our university internship program by attending weekly meetings, tracking assignments, monitoring progress, and helping ensure clear communication between our team and the interns.

- Executive Review Coordination

Organize presentations, creative projects, reports, and other materials requiring leadership review so deadlines and approvals remain on track.

-Marketing Operations

Maintain centralized project dashboards, organize supporting documentation, and help ensure our marketing department has accurate, up-to-date information across ongoing initiatives.

- Reporting Coordination

Assist with organizing recurring marketing reports and preparing summaries using information provided by other members of the marketing team.

- Vendor & Agency Coordination

Help coordinate communication with outside agencies, freelancers, and vendors by tracking timelines, deliverables, meeting notes, and outstanding action items.

- Influencer & Partnership Tracking

Maintain organized records for influencer campaigns, partnerships, and marketing collaborations, ensuring important information is easy to access and up to date.

- SOP & Resource Organization

Assist with organizing marketing documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and shared marketing resources as our department continues to grow.



Qualifications

We're looking for someone who is naturally organized, dependable, and proactive.

Marketing experience is helpful, but not required. We're far more interested in finding someone who enjoys creating structure, managing details, and helping busy teams stay organized.



Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following roles is preferred:

Executive Assistant | Senior Administrative Assistant | Marketing Assistant | Marketing Coordinator

Project Coordinator | Operations Coordinator | Virtual Executive Assistant |Project Management Assistant |Marketing Operations Assistant |Experience supporting executives, directors, or leadership teams is highly preferred.



Preferred Software Experience

Experience with the following tools is a plus:

Google Workspace | Asana | Slack | Basecamp | Notion | Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

WhatsApp | Zoom | Experience with marketing platforms such as WordPress, WooCommerce, Klaviyo, or Google Analytics is beneficial but not required.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 

- The ideal candidate is someone who:

- Is exceptionally organized and detail-oriented.

- Takes ownership and follows through without being asked.

- Communicates professionally in English.

- Can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Learns new software and systems quickly.

- Works well independently while collaborating with a team.

- Enjoys solving problems and improving processes.

- Maintains professionalism and confidentiality.

- Has a positive attitude and enjoys helping others succeed.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES: 

This role is designed to grow with the right person.

As you become familiar with our business and marketing operations, you'll have opportunities to expand your responsibilities and develop into one of several specialized career paths within our Marketing Services department. We believe in promoting from within and investing in team members who demonstrate initiative, reliability, and a commitment to excellence.



COMPENSATION: 

Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the role. Additional opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and performance-based salary reviews are available.



SUCESS IN THIS ROLE: \

The right person for this position is someone who enjoys helping others stay organized, takes pride in exceptional follow-through, and finds satisfaction in making sure projects move forward efficiently.

If you're someone who naturally brings order to busy environments and enjoys supporting a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.







RECAP OF CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: 

While every day is a little different, your primary responsibilities will include:

Keeping the Director of Marketing organized by tracking action items, deadlines, and priorities.

Monitoring multiple marketing projects to ensure they stay on schedule and nothing falls through the cracks.

Coordinating communication between internal team members, agencies, partners, vendors, and interns.

Organizing projects and timelines within Asana and maintaining our department's project tracker.

Monitoring
s, Slack, Basecamp, and other communication channels to identify important follow-up items.

Preparing simple status updates and summaries so leadership has clear visibility into ongoing projects.

Maintaining organized documentation, project resources, and supporting files across the marketing department.

Following up with team members to ensure tasks are completed on time and projects continue moving forward.

No two days will look exactly the same, but your role will always revolve around one core mission: keeping our marketing department organized, informed, and moving forward.

title: GoHighLevel (GHL) Systems Specialist — Part-Time | Existing Systems & Automation
description:
Long-term, part-time independent contractor.

FirstEditing is an established professional editing company serving authors, academics, and writers worldwide since 1993.



We are hiring an experienced GoHighLevel Specialist to take responsibility for our existing GHL systems, complete unfinished projects, troubleshoot integrations, and keep our sales and communication workflows operating reliably.



**This is not a new GHL setup or general virtual assistant position.**



We already have substantial systems in place. We need someone who can understand what exists, preserve working configurations, resolve problems, and complete assignments independently.



### Responsibilities



- Maintain and troubleshoot existing GHL workflows, funnels, forms, custom fields, and automations.

- Complete our funnel for Book Formatting: pricing, checkout, payment, and customer-intake funnel.

- Finalize and validate our AI chatbot integration and customer routing.

- Support our existing custom PHP/MySQL CRM-to-GHL integration, coordinating directly with our CRM developer.

- Maintain newsletter workflows, subscriptions, unsubscribes, contact synchronization, and
 delivery.

- Support GHL phone system & activation, SMS initiation, WhatsApp integration, and customer communication systems, as we transition from our old custom, bespoke CRM and stack.

- Troubleshoot integrations, webhooks, payment workflows, and contact data issues.

- Coordinate directly with our WordPress, CRM, and newsletter contractors.

- Perform controlled end-to-end testing and document whether the actual business outcome passes or fails.



### Required Qualifications



- At least 2 years of substantial hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- Proven experience troubleshooting existing GHL accounts, not just building new funnels.

- Strong understanding of workflows, triggers, conditional logic, custom fields, contact management, and opportunities.

- Experience with webhooks, APIs, and integrations involving external CRM systems.

- Experience with GHL payments, checkout forms, and Stripe integrations.

- Experience with
 workflows, deliverability, subscription management, and suppression rules.

- Ability to troubleshoot existing systems without introducing unnecessary complexity.

- Clear written English and reliable communication.

- Ability to work independently, coordinate with other contractors, and complete assignments within approved time caps.



Experience with WordPress/Elementor, Mailgun, WhatsApp/Meta, AI chatbots, and PHP-based CRM integrations is advantageous.



You do not need to be a PHP developer, WordPress developer, or newsletter copywriter. You must be able to coordinate effectively with specialists in those areas.



### How We Work



We value results over activity.



Before changing anything, understand the existing implementation, identify the actual failure, and recommend the smallest safe correction.



We expect:



- One accountable specialist who owns assigned outcomes through testing and completion.

- Prompt communication when blocked.

- No unauthorized production changes.

- No unnecessary rebuilding or new third-party integrations.

- Accurate, itemized timesheets.

- A short Thursday progress report using our existing reporting system.

- Clear PASS/FAIL evidence for completed technical work.



### How to Apply



**Required
/application subject: GHL RECOVERY — [Your Full Name]**



Include:



1. Your years of hands-on GHL experience and your requested hourly rate.

2. Two examples of EXISTING GHL systems you diagnosed and repaired, explaining the problem, your correction, and how you proved it worked.

3. Your experience with external CRM integrations, APIs, webhooks, and payment workflows.

4. Your experience with newsletter unsubscribes, suppression, and contact synchronization.

5. Your availability in hours per week and your usual working hours in Philippine time.



Please also answer:



**Scenario:** A contact unsubscribes from a newsletter in GHL, but an external CRM synchronization subsequently marks the contact as subscribed again. The customer receives another newsletter.



What would you check first? How would you correct the issue without disrupting the existing integration? How would you prove the correction worked?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical technical assessment.



We are looking for a reliable, long-term specialist who takes responsibility for working business outcomes—not someone who simply marks technical tasks complete.

title: Construction Compliance Specialist | Licensing, Insurance & Certified Payroll
description:
We are looking for an experienced Construction Compliance Specialist to manage contractor licensing, insurance compliance, certified payroll, prevailing wage requirements, GC prequalification, and regulatory registrations for our growing U.S. construction operation.



This role sits at the center of our operations and is responsible for making sure our company and projects remain licensed, insured, compliant, and ready to operate, bid, mobilize, and get paid.



The ideal candidate has experience supporting U.S. construction companies, contractors, subcontractors, or general contractors and is highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple deadlines across states, projects, and compliance requirements.



Key Responsibilities



Licensing & Business Registration



Maintain contractor licenses and business registrations across all states where we operate.



Track license and registration renewal deadlines and state filing calendars.



Proactively coordinate renewals before expiration.



Maintain the company's status on approved subcontractor/vendor lists with general contractors.



Keep compliance records and documentation organized and up to date.



Insurance, Bonding & COI Management



Maintain Certificates of Insurance (COIs) according to the specific requirements of general contractors and project owners.



Track insurance expiration dates and required coverage.



Manage state-specific workers' compensation requirements, including states that require direct accounts.



Coordinate bonding requirements for government and commercial contracts.



Assemble complete compliance packages prior to project mobilization.



Follow up with insurance providers, brokers, and internal teams to resolve documentation issues.

Research and obtain the appropriate wage determinations.



Manage California public works compliance, including DIR registration, DAS filings, and eCPR submissions.



Prepare and submit certified payroll reports accurately and on schedule.



Respond to agency inquiries related to certified payroll and prevailing wage requirements.



Notify the accounting/payroll team in writing of wage rates, classifications, and reporting schedules before payroll runs.



Maintain organized records of wage determinations, classifications, and payroll compliance documentation.

 registration and keep CAGE, UEI, and related identifiers current.

Monitor registration requirements and renewal deadlines.

Ability to manage multiple deadlines across different states, projects, and entities without dropping requirements.



Strong written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to independently track issues, follow up with stakeholders, and proactively prevent compliance lapses.



Proficiency with Google Drive and Microsoft Office.



Comfortable learning and working across multiple online platforms and databases.



Preferred Experience

Contractor licensing and state registrations



General contractor prequalification



Insurance compliance and Certificates of Insurance (COIs)



Workers' compensation requirements



Prevailing wage compliance



Davis-Bacon requirements



Certified payroll



California DIR



California DAS



California eCPR







CAGE / UEI



ISNetworld



Avetta



Textura



Procore



LCPTracker



Salesforce



Airtable

Government agencies

Internal leadership

title: Social Media Strategist & Content Lead for an Online Education Brand
description:
About Us



The Coaches Business Studio is an online learning platform designed to help coaches build, grow and develop successful coaching businesses.



We are creating a growing body of high-quality business education across areas such as positioning, personal brand, social media, finance, sales, associate coaching, corporate coaching, workshops, proposals and practice development.



One of the distinctive features of the Studio is our AI faculty. Each faculty member has their own area of expertise, personality and point of view, but the thinking, research, scripting and production behind the content is created by a real team.



We are currently building towards launch and already have a significant amount of video content in production.



We are now looking for someone to take ownership of the social media side of the business.



The Role



We are looking for someone who can think strategically about social media, work with us to shape the content plan, and then turn that thinking into an organised and consistent publishing operation.



You will work closely with the founder and our video production team.



We already have a clear overall social media strategy, including:



* different roles for YouTube, Instagram, 
 and

* clear content categories and editorial missions

* a strong distinction between free social content and paid learning inside the Studio

* a growing library of professionally produced video

* defined faculty characters and areas of expertise

* a clear brand direction



What we need is someone who can help turn that strategy into an intelligent, ongoing content system.



You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution.



One day you might be discussing whether an idea belongs on YouTube or LinkedIn.



The next, you might be writing the LinkedIn version of a video concept, briefing a carousel, preparing captions, building the publishing schedule, or d
 which short-form edit should be repurposed onto
.



You should be able to look at a piece of content and ask:



What is this trying to achieve? Who is it for? Which platform does it belong on? 

What is the strongest expression of the idea?



That kind of editorial judgement is central to the role.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



You will take responsibility for the planning and day-to-day management of the Studio’s social media presence across YouTube, Instagram, 
 and
.



The role will include:



* developing the ongoing social media plan in collaboration with the founder

* turning strategic themes into practical weekly and monthly content plans

* d
 which ideas belong on which platforms

* adapting ideas appropriately rather than simply reposting identical content everywhere

* writing captions, posts, hooks and supporting copy

* developing written LinkedIn content from broader Studio ideas

* identifying opportunities for Reels, Shorts, carousels, graphics and other social formats

* briefing the video production team on social-first creative requirements

* identifying useful edits and extracts from longer-form video

* conceptualising simple creative ideas that can be produced internally

* maintaining the publishing calendar

* scheduling and publishing content

* managing titles, descriptions, thumbnails, hashtags and platform metadata where relevant

* monitoring performance and identifying what is and is not working

* helping us gradually establish meaningful benchmarks for each platform

* bringing new ideas and recommendations rather than waiting to be told what to post



Over time, we would expect you to develop a strong understanding of the faculty, the Studio brand and the coaching-business market.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone with strong editorial judgement.



You do not need to be a coach, but you do need to be able to understand sophisticated professional content and turn it into social media that feels intelligent rather than generic.



You should have:



* strong social media strategy experience

* excellent written English

* strong copywriting and editing skills

* good visual judgement

* experience working across Instagram, YouTube, 
 and

* an understanding of how the same idea should be expressed differently on different platforms

* experience developing content calendars and editorial plans

* a good understanding of short-form video

* confidence working with long-form and short-form content together

* the ability to brief designers or video editors clearly

* the ability to distinguish between content that teaches, provokes, entertains, builds familiarity or creates desire

* confidence interpreting analytics without becoming obsessed with vanity metrics

* the ability to work independently and make decisions

* curiosity and willingness to challenge ideas when necessary



Experience with online education, coaching, professional services, creator-led businesses or membership brands would be useful, but is not essential.



What This Role Is Not



We are not looking for someone whose main skill is scheduling posts.



We are not looking for someone who relies heavily on generic content templates, motivational quotes or AI-generated filler.



We are not looking for someone who believes the answer to social media is simply “post more often”.



And we do not want identical content copied mechanically across every platform.

We care much more about strong ideas, good judgement and distinctive creative work.



How We Work



Our video team handles the core video production.



Your role would sit between strategy, editorial planning and distribution.



You would collaborate closely with the founder on ideas and direction, and with the production team on how those ideas are turned into finished creative assets.



We want someone who becomes part of the thinking behind the brand, rather than simply receiving a folder of finished videos and uploading them.



There is considerable scope to shape the role as the Studio grows.



To Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction explaining why this role interests you.

2. Examples of social media accounts or brands you have helped manage or grow.

3. Examples of content you personally conceptualised or wrote.

4. A brief explanation of how you would approach the same idea differently on:

    * YouTube

    * Instagram

    * LinkedIn

    *

5. An example of a social media brand you think does particularly good work, and why.



Please do not send a generic proposal. We are particularly interested in how you think.

title: Static Ad Creative Designer (AI Workflow: ChatGPT + Higgsfield)
description:
Static Ad Creative Designer (AI Workflow: ChatGPT + Higgsfield)

Remote | Freelance | Ongoing | Growth path to Creative Strategist



About us

We are an Amsterdam based e-commerce company running multiple DTC brands in personal care and health accessories, selling mainly through Meta ads across Europe. We test new creatives every week and we are looking for someone who can turn strategy into winning statics.



The role

You will produce static ad creatives for our brands. The creative strategy comes from us: we define the angles, hooks, audiences and offers. You’ll be guided by us directly and receive creative strategy directions from us, and you turn those briefs into high converting statics, ready to launch.



But we don’t want someone who only follows briefs. Next to executing our strategy, we expect you to do your own research: study competitors, ad libraries, customer reviews and trends, and come to us with angles and ideas of your own.



What matters to us

Hit rate over volume. We’d rather have 5 statics with one winner than 50 that go nowhere. Every static you deliver should be made to win.



What you’ll do



Turn creative briefs into statics with a clear angle and a reason to convert

Do your own research and pitch new angles, hooks and concepts

Generate and edit product visuals and lifestyle imagery with Higgsfield

Use ChatGPT for copy variations, headlines and image generation where it fits

Deliver in all required Meta formats (1:1, 4:5, 9:16) with clean, on brand layouts

Analyse performance with us and iterate: turn losers into winners, and winners into stronger variations

Hit agreed deadlines



What we’re looking for



A proven track record: preferably at least 10 winning statics, each with $10k+ in ad spend while maintaining the client’s KPIs

Hands on experience with both Higgsfield and ChatGPT in your daily workflow

Strong understanding of direct response: hooks, benefit callouts, social proof, before/after, us vs them, offer driven layouts

An analytical mind: you know why an ad wins or loses, not just that it did

Comfortable taking direction and receiving feedback

Good written English; Dutch, Polish or French is a plus (we sell in those markets)



Compensation

A base fee plus a share in the results. For every winning ad (meeting KPIs agreed with us upfront) you earn a 5% commission on the ad spend behind that ad.



Growth path

This role can grow into Creative Strategist, with a higher base and a higher commission scheme. That step is for someone who consistently delivers winners and shows strong strategic thinking through their own research and ideas.



How to apply

Send us:



Your portfolio with your best winning statics, including for each: brand, niche, ad spend and results (ROAS, CPA or CTR). Ads Manager screenshots are required

Your hit rate: roughly how many of the statics you make become winners

Your breakdown method: explain how you analyse winning and losing ads. What do you look at, and how do you d
 what to change?

Your losers: show 2 or 3 statics that lost, explain why they lost, and show the iteration you made that turned it into a winner, with the results

A short description of your workflow with ChatGPT and Higgsfield

title: Experienced Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator
description:
Company: GLS Group

Location: Philippines (Cebu preferred, applications welcome nationwide)

Employment: Full-time, long-term

Work Arrangement: Remote, with potential to transition to an office-based team

Reporting to: GLS Group Directors



About GLS Group



GLS Group is an international legal services business operating across Singapore, Dubai and other international markets.



We provide legal services to businesses through an innovative operating model, combining experienced lawyers, technology and efficient business processes.



Our businesses include legal operations consulting, managed legal services and innovative legal support solutions for startups and growing businesses.



We are expanding our international operations and establishing a dedicated Philippines-based support team.



The Opportunity



We are looking for an experienced, capable and highly organised Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator to take responsibility for the day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration of our four business entities.



We use Xero as our accounting platform, and practical experience with Xero is essential.



This is a hands-on position requiring someone who can independently manage the full range of bookkeeping responsibilities expected in a small international business.



You will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing invoicing and receivables, reconciling transactions, preparing monthly financial reports and working with our external accountants.



We want someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, identifies discrepancies, follows up on outstanding matters and ensures our financial records are consistently accurate and up to date.



Our objective is to have a well-managed bookkeeping function that operates reliably without requiring constant supervision from our Directors.



The position will also include general business administration and support for our growing marketing operations.



As we establish our Philippines-based support team, you will assist with marketing database maintenance, data entry and related administrative activities.



This will provide an opportunity to become familiar with our businesses, systems and operations while contributing to the development of our support team.



Key Responsibilities



1. Bookkeeping & Financial Records



Maintain accurate and complete bookkeeping records for four separate business entities.

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping activities using Xero.

Record and categorise income, expenses and financial transactions.

Maintain accurate general ledgers and supporting financial records.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards and payment transactions.

Identify and investigate discrepancies, missing transactions and incorrect allocations.

Maintain appropriate supporting documentation for all financial transactions.

Ensure financial records are complete, properly organised and available for review.

Maintain accurate intercompany transaction records and reconciliations.

Assist with month-end and year-end bookkeeping procedures.



2. Client Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



Prepare, generate and issue client invoices using Xero.

Ensure invoices are accurate, properly authorised and issued promptly.

Maintain accurate client billing records.

Record and allocate customer payments against outstanding invoices.

Monitor accounts receivable and overdue invoices.

Prepare regular aged receivables reports.

Follow up professionally on overdue payments.

Investigate discrepancies between invoices, receipts and customer accounts.

Maintain accurate records of credit notes, adjustments and refunds.

Assist with recurring invoices and subscription-based billing arrangements.



3. Accounts Payable & Expense Management



Receive, review and process supplier invoices.

Record expenses and allocate them to the correct accounts and business entities.

Reconcile expenses and supporting receipts using Xero.

Maintain accurate supplier records.

Monitor payment due dates and prepare payment schedules.

Identify duplicate invoices, incorrect charges and missing supporting documents.

Reconcile supplier statements and outstanding balances.

Track recurring business expenses and subscriptions.

Prepare payments for management approval.

Maintain accurate records of approved and completed payments.



4. Stripe & Online Payment Administration



We use Stripe to process online customer payments.



The successful candidate will be expected to become familiar with our Stripe payment processes and ensure transactions are accurately reflected in Xero.



Responsibilities include:



Monitor Stripe transactions, settlements and payouts.

Reconcile Stripe payments against customer invoices and bank receipts.

Record and reconcile Stripe processing fees.

Identify and investigate failed payments, refunds and discrepancies.

Assist with reconciling recurring payments and subscription transactions.

Maintain accurate records of online payment activity.

Ensure Stripe transactions are correctly allocated to the relevant business entity.

Help improve the integration and reconciliation processes between Stripe and Xero.



Previous experience with Stripe would be a significant advantage.



5. Monthly Financial Reporting



We expect our bookkeeping records to be sufficiently accurate and current to support reliable monthly management reporting.



Responsibilities include:



Prepare monthly Profit & Loss reports for each of our four business entities.

Prepare consolidated financial summaries for management review.

Produce monthly balance sheet reports.

Prepare aged receivables and aged payables reports.

Report on outstanding invoices and overdue customer payments.

Prepare monthly summaries of revenue, expenses and cash balances.

Identify unusual expenses, material variances and transactions requiring attention.

Assist with basic cash flow monitoring and forecasting.

Maintain monthly financial reporting schedules.

Ensure reports are prepared accurately and delivered on time.



We want someone who can do more than generate reports. We value candidates who can identify issues, explain discrepancies and highlight matters requiring management attention.



6. External Accountants & Compliance Support



We engage external accountants to support our accounting, tax and statutory reporting obligations.



The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring our accountants receive accurate, complete and well-organised financial information.



Responsibilities include:



Act as the principal administrative contact for our external accountants.

Maintain organised financial records and supporting documentation.

Prepare and provide requested financial reports and reconciliations.

Maintain records of invoices, receipts, expenses and other financial transactions.

Assist with preparing information required for tax filings and statutory reporting.

Respond to accountants' questions and requests for supporting information.

Track outstanding accounting queries and ensure timely responses.

Assist with year-end financial reporting and audit preparation.

Maintain a structured database of financial records and documents for each entity.

Help ensure financial reporting and compliance deadlines are met.



7. General Business Administration



In addition to bookkeeping, the role will include general administrative support.



Responsibilities include:



Maintain accurate customer and supplier databases.

Assist with administrative record keeping and document management.

Prepare spreadsheets, reports and business records.

Help maintain organised electronic filing systems.

Support improvements to internal administrative processes.

Assist with routine operational tasks as required.



8. Marketing Database & Business Development Support



GLS Group is expanding its marketing operations and establishing a dedicated Philippines-based marketing support team.



Initially, you will assist with certain marketing administration and database-related activities.



These may include:



Maintaining and updating contact databases.

Entering, reviewing and correcting customer and prospect information.

Identifying and removing duplicate or inaccurate records.

Assisting with database segmentation and categorisation.

Supporting the preparation of contact lists for marketing campaigns.

Helping maintain accurate records in ActiveCampaign and related systems.

Assisting with other routine marketing administration tasks.



As our marketing team expands, dedicated marketing specialists will assume responsibility for these activities.



This is an opportunity to develop a broader understanding of our businesses while helping establish the systems and processes that will support our future growth.



What We're Looking For



Essential Requirements



At least five years of practical bookkeeping experience, preferably supporting small or medium-sized businesses.

Strong working knowledge of Xero, including invoicing, bank reconciliation, expense management and financial reporting.

Experience managing the full bookkeeping cycle.

Demonstrated ability to prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements and other management reports.

Experience managing accounts receivable, accounts payable and bank reconciliations.

Strong Microsoft Excel skills.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Very good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.

Ability to work independently, identify problems and take ownership of their resolution.

Confidence communicating with Directors, suppliers, customers and external accountants.

Comfortable using AI tools to improve productivity.

A dedicated, quiet home office, suitable for professional video calls and uninterrupted work, with reliable high-speed internet.



Highly Desirable



Previous experience managing bookkeeping for multiple business entities.

Experience with Stripe payment processing and reconciliation.

Experience working with international businesses.

Familiarity with Singapore or UAE accounting and reporting requirements.

Experience with recurring invoicing and subscription-based businesses.

Experience with professional services businesses.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and SharePoint.

Experience with ActiveCampaign or similar CRM platforms.

Experience maintaining business databases and administrative records.

What We Offer

A long-term position with an established international business.

Responsibility for the bookkeeping and financial administration of four business entities.

Direct interaction with senior management.

Interesting and varied responsibilities.

Opportunities to develop financial, administrative and operational skills.

Exposure to international business operations.

The opportunity to help establish and develop our Philippines-based support team.

How to Apply



Please submit:



Your CV, detailing your relevant bookkeeping experience.

Your current or most recent monthly salary.

Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Your availability to commence employment.

A short video introduction (maximum two minutes) explaining your professional background, bookkeeping experience and why you are interested in this position.



You may record the video using your phone or computer. No special equipment or editing is required. Please provide the video or a shareable link that can be viewed without requesting access.



Please also answer the following questions:



1. Xero Experience



How many years have you used Xero, and which bookkeeping functions have you personally managed using the platform?



2. Multiple Entities



Have you previously managed bookkeeping for more than one business entity? If so, how many, and what were your responsibilities?



3. Monthly Reporting



What financial reports did you prepare in your most recent position? Were you personally responsible for preparing monthly Profit & Loss statements?



4. Stripe Experience



Have you worked with Stripe or another online payment platform? If so, explain how you reconciled customer payments, transaction fees and bank settlements.



5. Independent Responsibility



Describe a bookkeeping discrepancy or financial reporting problem you personally identified and resolved.



We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate accuracy, initiative, sound judgment, reliability and the ability to manage their responsibilities independently.

title: Full-Time Video Editor — Movement, Anatomy & Meaningful Education
description:
This role will challenge and grow you.



I’m looking for a skilled video editor to help me produce content that blends science, movement and healing.



If you enjoy clear educational storytelling, clean motion design and visuals that help people understand what they’re seeing, this could be a great fit.



You need strong video editing and motion graphics skills. Experience superimposing skeletal anatomy onto human movement is welcome, but you can learn that application in this role. You’ll need the interest, initiative and technical foundation to develop it.



Who I Am



I run two yoga-based companies:



* One trains yoga professionals in anatomy-informed, therapeutic practice.

* The other helps people reduce pain and rebuild trust in their bodies through mindful movement.



My teaching brings biomechanics and yoga together. The visuals need to reflect that: calm, focused and clear. Not flashy, chaotic or driven by constant jump cuts.



I work with a small team of VAs hired through this platform. We work well together, enjoy what we’re building, and I’m looking for someone who would enjoy contributing to that team.



What You’ll Produce



Our regular weekly output will be:



* One 7–10-minute YouTube video.

* Five 1–3-minute clips, each formatted for YouTube, Instagram and
.

* Thumbnails, titles and descriptions, plus uploading and scheduling.



The footage will include me teaching to camera and demonstrating movement. Short clips will come from both longer recordings and separately recorded short videos.



Skeletal overlays will appear in selected sections where they help explain the teaching - not throughout every video. Other visuals may include animated diagrams, simple text and anatomical illustrations.



We’ll begin with a production phase to build a buffer of content before moving into the regular publishing schedule. Together, we’ll agree on a realistic timeline for getting a few weeks ahead and maintaining that buffer.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



* Editing long-form and short-form educational videos.

* Selecting useful excerpts from longer recordings while preserving the meaning of the teaching.

* Superimposing skeletal and anatomical visuals onto movement footage.

* Creating clear, purposeful motion graphics.

* Polishing audio, captions, pacing and visual consistency.

* Creating thumbnails and writing titles and descriptions that accurately reflect the content.

* Formatting, uploading and scheduling approved videos across platforms.

* Keeping footage, assets, exports and editable project files organized in our shared storage.



Editable project files and the assets needed to continue working on them must be included in the handoff, alongside final exported videos.



Anatomical Accuracy and Learning



You’ll provide the editing software, tools and appropriately licensed anatomy assets needed for your work.



I can provide direction about the anatomy, movement and what a visual needs to communicate. You’ll also be expected to develop your understanding over time and take initiative in learning how to create accurate overlays.



Anatomical accuracy matters, as does preserving the meaning of my teaching. When something is unclear, I want you to ask.



I’ll provide feedback and final approval before content is published.



Who This Role Is For



You’re someone who:



* Has strong editing and motion graphics skills.

* Can already create skeletal overlays or is ready to learn.

* Understands how pacing and visual tone support calm, clear education.

* Enjoys making complex ideas easier to understand.

* Is collaborative, detail-oriented and reliable.

* Can manage deadlines and communicate progress without micromanagement.

* Responds well to feedback and grows more independent as you learn the work.



Experience with education, health or wellness content is welcome.



Tools and Technical Skills



Please tell me which software and subscriptions you have and use confidently.



Relevant skills include:



* Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, or equivalent tools.

* Motion tracking and compositing.

* Animated diagrams and simple text animation.

* Talking-head editing and audio cleanup.

* Long-form educational pacing.

* Short-form editing and platform formatting.

* Thumbnail creation and consistent visual design.



You’ll also need stable, strong internet for transferring footage and project files.



Working Together



This is intended to be a full-time role.



You can organize your working hours around agreed deadlines. I’m in Mountain Time and typically connect in the early morning. Please tell me your time zone and your availability to meet during that window.



Skill, reliability, communication and meeting deadlines matter most.



Examples of My Existing Content



Skeletal overlays:





See 10:34.





See 5:51.



Other teaching visuals:





See 2:44, 3:33 and 5:23.





See 0:51, 5:06, 5:21, 6:49 and 7:06.



To Apply



Please:



* Share your editing and motion graphics portfolio.

* Include up to two examples of skeletal overlays if you have them. If this is new for you, share relevant tracking or compositing work and explain what you would need to learn.

* Confirm which editing tools and subscriptions you have.

* Confirm that you have stable, strong internet.

* Tell me about any experience with education, health or wellness brands.

* Confirm your availability for full-time work, your time zone and your availability for early-morning Mountain Time meetings.

* Include your expected compensation.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a small test using my footage, including a brief skeletal overlay section.



If you enjoy creating intelligent, thoughtful visuals and want to grow alongside this work, I’d love to hear from you.
