title: Marketing Database Growth & Website Content Specialist
description:
# Marketing Database Growth & Website Content Specialist



**Company:** GLS Group

**Location:** Philippines (Cebu preferred, applications welcome nationwide)

**Employment:** Full-time, long-term

**Work Arrangement:** Remote, with potential to transition to an office-based team

**Reporting to:** GLS Group Directors / Marketing Operations Lead



### About GLS Group



GLS Group is an international legal services business operating across Singapore, Dubai and other international markets.



Our businesses provide legal operations consulting, managed legal services and innovative legal support solutions for startups and growing businesses.



We operate several websites and maintain substantial databases of corporate contacts, professional decision-makers, customers and prospective clients.



We are expanding our international marketing activities and establishing a dedicated Philippines-based marketing support team.



### The Opportunity



We are looking for an organised, resourceful and detail-oriented **Marketing Database Growth & Website Content Specialist**.



This position has two principal responsibilities:



**1. Marketing Database Growth**



Research companies and professional contacts, identify relevant decision-makers and systematically expand our marketing databases.



**2. Website Content Publishing**



Upload, format and publish articles, blogs, marketing materials and other content across our websites.



We already produce substantial marketing content and have clear target audiences.



Your responsibility will be to ensure our databases continue to grow and our content is published accurately, professionally and consistently.



**We want someone who enjoys research, is comfortable working with digital systems and takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work.**



This is a hands-on role offering an opportunity to develop practical experience in international digital marketing operations.



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Marketing Database Research & Growth**



An important part of this position will be systematically expanding our databases of relevant companies and professional contacts.



Responsibilities include:



* Research companies operating in our target industries and geographic markets.

* Identify relevant business decision-makers and professional contacts.

* Research general counsel, legal operations leaders, legal executives, founders and senior business managers.

* Identify companies matching defined target customer profiles.

* Research and record relevant company and contact information.

* Use LinkedIn, company websites, professional directories and other research sources.

* Identify and verify professional
 addresses using appropriate tools.

* Maintain accurate records of research sources and contact information.

* Organise prospects into clearly defined target groups.

* Support the development of targeted marketing contact lists.

* Work towards agreed database growth and research targets.



**We are looking for someone who can research intelligently, rather than simply copy information from websites.**



**2. Database Management & Data Quality**



Database quality is as important as database growth.



Responsibilities include:



* Maintain accurate and organised contact records.

* Identify and remove duplicate contacts.

* Correct incomplete, inconsistent or outdated information.

* Categorise contacts by geography, industry, company and professional role.

* Maintain consistent database formatting and naming conventions.

* Import and export contact information using Excel, CSV files and CRM systems.

* Assist with maintaining contact records in ActiveCampaign.

* Identify and flag inaccurate or questionable information.

* Maintain appropriate records of contact sources and marketing permissions.

* Follow established data protection and database management procedures.



**3. Website Content Uploading & Publishing**



GLS Group operates several websites containing articles, resources, marketing materials and educational content.



We regularly produce new material that needs to be uploaded and published.



Responsibilities include:



* Upload articles, blogs and other written content to our websites.

* Format headings, paragraphs, lists, tables and other content elements.

* Add images, graphics and supporting documents.

* Insert internal and external hyperlinks.

* Upload downloadable resources and marketing materials.

* Apply consistent formatting and presentation standards.

* Check spelling, layout and formatting before publication.

* Ensure content displays correctly on desktop and mobile devices.

* Update existing website pages when required.

* Maintain organised records of published content.

* Identify and report broken links, formatting problems and publishing errors.



**4. Search Engine Optimisation & Content Administration**



You will assist with the practical SEO requirements associated with publishing website content.



Responsibilities include:



* Enter SEO titles and meta descriptions.

* Apply appropriate headings and content structures.

* Add image descriptions and alternative text.

* Maintain appropriate page URLs and content categories.

* Add internal links to relevant website resources.

* Assist with keyword placement based on supplied instructions.

* Check published content for basic SEO requirements.

* Help maintain consistent website content standards.



You will not be expected to develop our SEO strategy. However, you should understand how to publish content in a search-engine-friendly manner.



**5. Marketing Administration & Support**



As part of our growing marketing team, you will also assist with routine marketing administration.



Responsibilities include:



* Prepare and maintain marketing spreadsheets.

* Assist with organising campaign contact lists.

* Support database segmentation activities.

* Maintain records of marketing content and publication schedules.

* Assist with ActiveCampaign contact administration.

* Support LinkedIn research and prospect identification.

* Help maintain accurate marketing records.

* Coordinate with the Marketing Operations Lead and other team members.

* Assist with other marketing support activities when required.



### What We're Looking For



**Essential Requirements**



* At least three years of relevant experience in database research, lead generation, data administration or website content publishing.

* Demonstrated experience researching companies and professional contacts.

* Strong internet research skills.

* Excellent Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Experience working with CRM systems or structured contact databases.

* Experience uploading and formatting website content using a content management system.

* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

* **Very good written and spoken English**, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage repetitive tasks accurately.

* Ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines.

* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research and productivity.

* Willingness to learn new systems and processes.

* **A dedicated, quiet home office**, suitable for professional video calls and uninterrupted work, with reliable high-speed internet.



**Highly Desirable**



* Experience using LinkedIn for professional contact research.

* Experience with lead research tools such as Apollo, Hunter or similar platforms.

* Experience with ActiveCampaign or comparable CRM systems.

* Experience with WordPress or other website content management systems.

* Familiarity with SEO publishing requirements.

* Experience using Canva or basic image editing tools.

* Experience supporting B2B marketing campaigns.

* Experience researching international business contacts.

* Experience working with professional services businesses.



### What We Offer



* A long-term position with an established international business.

* Interesting and varied responsibilities.

* Exposure to international business and marketing operations.

* Opportunities to develop practical digital marketing skills.

* Training and experience with professional marketing systems.

* The opportunity to become part of a growing Philippines-based marketing team.

* Direct involvement in expanding our international marketing presence.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV.

2. Your current or most recent monthly salary.

3. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

4. Your availability to commence employment.

5. **A short video introduction (maximum two minutes)** explaining your professional background, relevant experience and why you are interested in this position.



You may record the video using your phone or computer. No special equipment or editing is required. Please provide the video or a shareable link that can be viewed without requesting access.



**Please also answer the following questions:**



**1. Database Research**



Describe your experience researching companies and professional contacts. Which websites, databases or research tools have you used?



**2. Database Growth**



Approximately how many new, verified professional contacts could you research and accurately record during a typical working day?



Please explain your assumptions.



**3. Website Publishing**



Which website content management systems have you used?



Describe the types of content you have personally uploaded and published.



**4. Data Quality**



How do you check that contact information is accurate and avoid creating duplicate records?



**5. SEO Experience**



What steps would you take when uploading a new article to ensure it is properly formatted and optimised for search engines?



We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate **accuracy, productivity, initiative, resourcefulness and the ability to work independently.**

title: Short-Form Video Editor: Entertainment Content (Long-Term)
description:
If you're tired of one-off gigs and clients who disappear after three videos, this this is for you. It's steady, ongoing work with the same clients every week.



We're a content agency. We work with entertainers and creators, we take their raw footage and turn it into short clips for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and
. We put out
clips a month across our roster.



You'll get your own set of clients and own their clips. Our editors stay with us long-term and their rosters grow over time.



ABOUT THE STYLE



You get full creative freedom. We don't have one house style you have to copy. We want our clients to look different from each other, not all cut from the same template. So you bring your own touch and adapt it to the clients you work with.



What isn't flexible: captions have to be accurate, timing has to be tight, and due dates get hit. Get those right and the creative side is yours.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit clips for your assigned clients: captions, graphics, hooks, cuts

- Develop a look that suits each client you work with

- Hit your weekly due dates

- Get clips right the first time. Rework costs you time and us the posting schedule

- Be available for two short calls and one team meeting a week, and daily communication on slack while working.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

- You can edit short-form social video (CapCut, Premiere etc) - We supply you with CapCut Pro

- Your English is strong enough to caption fast, casual US speech accurately, slang, accents and people talking over each other. This is the most important skill in the role

- You're detail-focused. Caption typos and timing slips matter more here than anything else

- You can work at volume without quality dropping

- You can commit to a consistent weekly schedule



EQUIPMENT

- You need a computer that handles video work, reliable internet, and storage space for raw footage. We send a lot of it and you'll be holding it while you work. An external hard drive is the normal setup, but plenty of free space on your computer works too.



PAY: Per approved clip:

- $2.00 for your first 50 clips

- $2.50 for the next 50

- $3.00 after that

Plus a $15/week base fee for availability: calls, team meetings, Slack, and going through training material.



Once you're up to speed with a full client roster, that works out to roughly $1,000/month plus the base. Our current editors are at that level.



HOW TO APPLY

- Put "CLIPMAKER" in your subject line.



Send:

- Your portfolio, or 2–3 short-form clips you've edited (links, not attachments)

- Your weekly availability in hours and your time zone

- Your storage setup, external drive size and free space, or free space on your computer



Shortlisted applicants get a short test: one raw set, one clip, cut to timestamps we provide. Every applicant gets the same footage so we can compare fairly.



Independent contractor, remote.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

title: Senior Outsourced Technical Services Manager (TSM)
description:
About Qore Team

Qore Team provides outsourced growth and operational services to businesses, including managed remote IT support and technical service delivery. We are expanding our technical-management capability to support our internal service operation, a UK-based sister company and additional outsourcing clients.



The opportunity

We are seeking a highly experienced, technically credible IT leader who can build and run a disciplined remote technical operation while acting as a trusted outsourced Technical Services Manager for client organisations. This is a dual-remit, hands-on leadership role—not a help-desk-only, purely administrative or advisory post.



INTERNAL DELIVERY LEAD

Build service processes, direct remote engineers, improve performance and quality, control technical escalations, and scale a repeatable support function.



OUTSOURCED CLIENT TSM

Own the customer-facing technical relationship, oversee client support performance and projects, advise stakeholders, and lead practical IT improvements.



What you will own

1  Remote technical-team leadership and service operations

•  Lead, allocate and quality-check the work of remote L1/L2/L3 engineers and external specialists across multiple customer environments.

•  Coach and develop engineers through 1:1s, call/ticket reviews, skills assessments, technical mentoring, onboarding and measurable improvement plans.

•  Own help-desk priorities, SLAs, escalations, ticket ageing, reopenings, customer updates, capacity planning and effective handovers.

•  Set service standards, support boundaries, runbooks, knowledge articles and technical documentation that enable consistent delivery and continuity.

•  Act as the senior escalation point for complex i
; bring structure to root-cause analysis, corrective action and major service recovery.



2  Outsourced IT management and customer liaison

•  Act as the accountable IT/technical-service lead for assigned outsourcing clients, initially including a UK-based sister company.

•  Build effective relationships with directors, operational leaders, education-sector stakeholders and nominated client contacts; translate technical issues into business impact and decisions.

•  Lead technical service reviews, operational reporting, risk and lifecycle assessments, improvement roadmaps, project meetings and supplier escalations.

•  Own service-optimisation actions and oversee client delivery against agreed contracts, SLAs, budgets and authorised scopes without making unapproved commercial commitments.

•  Support technical scoping, effort estimates, project proposals, standardisation and sensible technology recommendations for clients.



3  Advanced Microsoft 365, cloud and identity

•  Provide expert oversight of Microsoft 365 administration, tenant health, migrations and i
 resolution, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and collaboration controls.

•  Lead Entra ID, identity and access governance, MFA, Conditional Access, licensing, Microsoft Intune / endpoint management, and Microsoft Defender / security configuration.

•  Review security posture, mail flow, permissions, device policy, configuration drift and service lifecycle; guide engineers through remediation and documented changes.

•  Work confidently with associated Azure/cloud services, hybrid identity and integration dependencies where present.



4  Networking, wireless, server and remote-access architecture

•  Design, diagnose and improve business networking: switching, routing, firewalls, VLANs, WAN, site-to-site and remote-access VPNs, TCP/IP, DNS and DHCP.

•  Own wireless architecture and troubleshooting: access-point placement, coverage and capacity, roaming, channel planning, authentication, segmentation and security for business and school environments.

•  Support Windows Server and hybrid estates including Active Directory, Group Policy, file services, virtualisation, backup dependencies and operational resilience.

•  Provide technical leadership for Remote Desktop, RDS and other approved remote-access technologies, including permissions and secure administration.



5  RMM, help desk, patches and endpoint standards

•  Manage remote monitoring and management (RMM), asset visibility, alerting, endpoint maintenance and proactive fault identification across client estates.

•  Own the controlled deployment of Windows, server, application and security updates, including patch policy, testing, rollout rings, scheduling, failure remediation and rollback.

•  Drive help-desk quality through clear tickets, next actions, accurate time recording, knowledge capture, escalation controls and meaningful performance dashboards.

•  Evaluate safe automation and standard configurations to reduce repeat i
, avoidable manual work and service risk.



6  Remote project and deployment leadership

•  Plan and lead remote Microsoft 365, endpoint, server, network and wireless deployments, upgrades and migrations, coordinating engineers, stakeholders and third-party vendors.

•  Define technical scope, dependencies, milestones, owners, labour estimates, access requirements, test plans, cutovers, customer communication and acceptance criteria.

•  Control delivery risks, project hours, change approval, backups, rollback arrangements, documentation, handover and lessons learned.

•  Use agreed project systems and ensure client commitments remain realistic, properly authorised and visible to the Managing Director.



7  Security, governance and continuous improvement

•  Apply least privilege, secure remote access, MFA, endpoint security, data protection, supplier coordination and robust change management.

•  Coordinate major outages, suspected cyber i
, evidence preservation, customer communication, recovery actions and preventative measures.

•  Understand UK GDPR obligations and the additional safeguarding and filtering/monitoring expectations when supporting schools.

•  Provide the Managing Director with concise, evidence-based reporting on customer risks, service performance, technical debt, projects, engineer development and decisions required.



Essential experience and capabilities

•  Typically 8+ years in IT infrastructure, technical support and service delivery, including at least 3 years leading or managing technical engineers; equivalent demonstrable experience is welcomed.

•  Proven remote team management and engineer coaching, including improvement of service quality, delivery discipline and individual performance.

•  Advanced hands-on technical capability across Microsoft 365 and associated identity, security, collaboration and device-management services.

•  Advanced networking and wireless architecture, Windows Server, Active Directory, Remote Desktop/RDS and secure remote access.

•  Operational experience with RMM, help-desk/ticketing platforms, patch/update deployments and structured i
 management.

•  Ability to scope and lead technical projects and deployments remotely, manage competing customer priorities and apply change controls.

•  Strong client communication, ownership of service outcomes, problem-solving judgement, English written/verbal skills and executive-level reporting.

•  Comfortable working autonomously in a growing services business, building practical processes while remaining willing to handle complex technical escalations.

•  Able to maintain the agreed full-time UK-business-hours service coverage from a reliable, professional and secure remote working environment.



Preferred experience

•  Managed Service Provider (MSP), IT outsourcing or multi-client technical-services leadership, especially in UK-facing delivery teams.

•  Support for UK businesses, schools/education, charities or similarly regulated customer environments.

•  Zoho Desk, Zoho Projects and Zoho Assist; Datto RMM; Microsoft Intune, Defender, Azure and Entra.

•  Cisco, Fortinet or comparable firewall/switching platforms; business Wi-Fi design, RADIUS, web filtering and monitoring.

•  Backup/disaster recovery, cybersecurity/MDR, business connectivity or VoIP; ITIL, Microsoft, networking or project-management certifications.

•  Technical pre-sales, project estimation, client roadmap/QBR delivery, service profitability or contract-scope management.



What success looks like in your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS Understand client obligations and technical estates; assess engineer capability, help-desk/RMM/patching maturity and major risks; establish clear escalation and customer-reporting routines.



BY 60 DAYS Agree a service-improvement roadmap and baseline KPIs; implement priority ticket, documentation and patching controls; launch structured engineer coaching and client service reviews.



BY 90 DAYS Lead measurable improvements in one or more client environments, demonstrate controlled project delivery, show reduced recurring issues and maintain a reliable operating/reporting cadence.



Performance will be assessed against service responsiveness and backlog health, i
/reopen trends, patch compliance, project outcomes, documentation quality, customer confidence and measurable engineer development.



Availability and contractor terms

Reliable availability during agreed UK business hours is essential, including adjustment when UK clocks change. Typical UK daytime coverage translates to late afternoon/evening in the Philippines and may extend past midnight. Confirm any constraints before applying. Exact coverage blocks and the 40-hour weekly scope will be agreed in writing.



•  This is an ongoing, full-time independent contractor engagement. The gross fee, scope, weekly hours, currency, invoicing and payment terms will be confirmed in a written agreement. 



•  You are responsible for applicable registrations, permissions, tax returns and payments, bookkeeping, invoicing, social contributions, insurance, healthcare and provision for time off.



•  Provide and maintain a suitable computer, headset, secure workspace, reliable internet and power, with practical backup arrangements. Include normal equipment, utilities, connectivity and operating costs in the quoted fee.



•  Use only approved remote-access, RMM, ticketing and security systems; protect client information and observe confidentiality, least-privilege and information-security requirements.



•  No separate employee benefits, allowances or reimbursements are included unless agreed in writing or required by applicable law. Client-specific licences, approved technical access and additional expenses are handled separately; expenditure requires prior approval.



•  Organise your work independently to deliver agreed results, availability, service levels and security outcomes. The written agreement and actual working arrangements must comply with applicable law; statutory rights and obligations are not waived by describing the engagement as contracting.



How to apply

Apply through this job board or contact recruitment at 
, quoting “Senior IT Manager / Outsourced Technical Services Manager”. We review suitable applications as they arrive.



•  CV and a short explanation of why you suit this combination of hands-on technical leadership and outsourced client IT management.



•  Technical leadership: number and level of engineers managed, service environment, and one specific coaching or operational-improvement result.



•  Technical project: one Microsoft 365, server, network or wireless deployment you led remotely, covering your decisions, team, delivery risks and outcome.



•  Client-facing work: examples of MSP/client service ownership, UK clients, education-sector support, escalations, roadmaps or technical service reviews.



•  Technology summary: practical experience across M365, Entra/Intune, networking/wireless, Windows Server, RDS, RMM, help desk, patching, Zoho and Datto where applicable.



•  Earliest realistic start date, notice period, full UK-hours availability, expected gross monthly contractor fee (PHP/GBP/USD) and the weekly hours included.



Shortlisted candidates may complete an interview, a practical Microsoft 365 / infrastructure assessment, and an IT-management scenario involving engineer coaching, a technical escalation or a remote deployment. Please anonymise case studies and do not submit confidential customer data, credentials or restricted system documentation.



We are actively recruiting. Please make your relevant MSP experience, UK-hours availability and gross fee expectations clear in your application.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Pantry Partners 



Multi-brand CPG support · Founding team member · Build the systems from day 



 Applications Only - no platform applications considered 



ABOUT PANTRY PARTNERS 



Pantry Partners is the back office behind ambitious, founder-led food and drink brands. We run the operations, admin, content and data that founders don't have time for, so they can focus on building the brand. We're also a venture studio, launching and incubating our own brands alongside the ones we support.



We're led by an exited founder who spent 10 years building and scaling a CPG food brand in Ireland. That experience shaped one belief: founders need to focus on their zone of genius to create generation defining brands. This  is almost never back office functions and that's where Pantry Partners comes in. 



We're brand new. There's no rulebook, no legacy process and no "that's how we've always done it". For the right person, that's the exciting part. If you love creating systems, defining ways of working and seeing your structure become the way a whole company runs, you'll help build Pantry Partners from the ground up.



A FLAVOUR FOR THE ROLE 



You'll be the organisational backbone across our portfolio of brands. Each founder gets a dedicated 2 hours of your day. 

You'll start with two: one existing external client brand and one brand we're incubating in-house. The rest of your week goes into building Pantry Partners itself: the SOPs, templates and tools that let us take on new brands without starting from scratch. Your job is to keep each brand's engine running quietly in the background, so founders can spend their time on creative, strategic, high-value work. 



THE BREAD AND BUTTER



• Founder Inbox triage and daily briefing - Work through each founder's inbox every morning. Send a short daily brief on what needs attention, framed against that founders' priorities. The founder d
, you execute.



• Calendar and scheduling - Own calendars across brands. Protect focus time, batch meetings, and make sure every meeting has a purpose and an agenda.



• General business admin - Keep the day-to-day running smoothly: organised shared drives, filed contracts and documents, tracked software subscriptions, and collected receipts. Stay ahead of renewals and deadlines, prepare forms and paperwork, and tidy up documents and decks so they're ready to send.



• Invoicing and light bookkeeping for Pantry Partners - Raise invoices on schedule, track payments and follow up on overdue ones. Keep a clean running record of income and outgoings that's easy to review at a glance.



• Research - Markets, suppliers, competitors, retailers, guests for content. Go deep and come back with a clean, one-page summary.



• Data cleaning - Turn messy spreadsheets, contact lists and databases into something usable. Founders shouldn't have to touch raw data.



• Meeting notes and follow-ups - Capture decisions and actions from virtual note taker, then make sure they happen.



• Travel and logistics for Pantry Partners founder - Book flights, accommodation and transfers for trade shows, supplier visits and meetings.



• Systems and SOPs - Document every recurring task as a repeatable process. Build the templates, trackers and checklists that let Pantry Partners support new brands without starting from scratch.



• Founder life admin and goals - Help the Pantry Partners founder stay on top of a varied life across countries, businesses and commitments. Manage personal appointments, bills and renewals, and keep work and personal plans from clashing. Support his personal operating system (The Engine) by tracking goals, weekly metrics and 90-day priorities, flagging where he's off track and prompting him on commitments. Essentially you're keeping a busy, curious person accountable! 



OUR ESSENTIAL INGREDIENTS 



• Time is sacred - Your core job is to buy back founders' time. Every task you take off their plate is a win. Every unnecessary interruption is a loss.



• Low noise - Don't bring problems, bring recommendations. Batch your questions. Only ask when you genuinely need a decision.



• Systems, not reminders - Build repeatable processes so nothing falls through the cracks. Nobody should need to chase you on recurring work.



• Clean separation - Each brand gets its own time, focus and confidentiality. What happens in one brand stays in that brand.



YOUR SECRET SAUCE - WHY YOU ARE PERFECT FOR PANTRY PARTNERS 



• You have Marie Kondo levels of organisation: everything has a place, nothing is left vague or half-done. 



• You communicate clearly and directly, without fluff. If something needs doing, you do it. You don't wait to be asked twice.



• You're energised by building something new. Early-stage brands mean shifting priorities and plenty of ambiguity, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none. Juggling several brands doesn't faze you, because you've built the system that keeps them separate.



• You bring a positive, sunny attitude. We believe work can and should be fun, so let's lean into that. 



YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU ARE: 



• Obsessively organised and analytical

• Proactive and self-directed

• A systems builder who loves documenting how things work

• Excellent in written and spoken English

• Low-ego and comfortable owning outcomes

• Confident with Google Workspace, spreadsheets and project-management tools (Trello, Notion or similar)



Experience supporting e-commerce, food, drink or consumer brands is a bonus, not a requirement.



WE'RE SERVING UP 



• Hours: Full-time from day one - 40 hours a week (8 hours a day, 5 days a week, Monday to Friday).

• Timezone: Flexible within Manila hours. We'll agree a daily overlap window for each brand where possible.

• Communication: Mostly async via WhatsApp ,
 and other shared tools, with short briefing calls as needed.

• Trial: A paid, part-time trial of 2–4 weeks before we formalise, with hours to be mutually agreed, at ₱350 per hour.

• Pay: €840 per month, plus 13th month pay.

• Growth: This is a long-term, founding role. As Pantry Partners grows, so does your responsibility, with a clear path to leading the support team.



HOW TO APPLY 



Record a short video (2 minutes max, Loom is perfect) walking us through something you've organised: your Google Drive, your week, even your kitchen cupboard. Show us how it works and why you set it up that way. Send it with your CV, using the subject line "Reporting for Pantry Duty: [your favourite food]".

title: Head of Marketing
description:
# Head of Marketing & Agent Growth



**Company:** Confidential Real Estate Brokerage

**Department:** Marketing & Agent Growth

**Reports To:** CEO

**Location:** Remote, with occasional travel for meetings, trainings, and events

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Compensation:** Base salary plus performance-based compensation tied to marketing services revenue, client growth, retention, and agreed marketing outcomes.



## About the Company



The Company is a growing, relationship-first real estate brokerage focused on helping agents build stronger and more sustainable businesses through leadership, coaching, marketing, technology, AI, systems, and community.



The Marketing Services Division provides done-for-you marketing and personal-brand support to help agents stay visible, build relationships, strengthen their brands, and generate new business opportunities.



## About the Role



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth will lead the Company’s overall marketing strategy, support agents with their individual marketing needs, and drive the growth of the Marketing Services Division.



This is a strategic, relationship-driven, and revenue-focused role — not primarily a graphic design or production position.



The person in this role will work directly with agents to understand their businesses, identify marketing opportunities, recommend solutions, introduce appropriate marketing services, guide agents through the sales process, and oversee onboarding and fulfillment coordination.



## Key Responsibilities



### Marketing Strategy & Brand Leadership



* Develop and manage the Company’s overall marketing strategy.

* Create marketing plans that support recruiting, agent retention, training, company growth, culture, and brand awareness.

* Strengthen the Company’s positioning, messaging, and brand voice.

* Turn company goals into campaigns, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

* Lead campaign strategy, messaging, copywriting, and creative direction.

* Maintain marketing, content, training, and event calendars.

* Review campaign performance and recommend improvements.

* Ensure consistent branding across websites, email, social media, community platforms, YouTube, presentations, and agent communications.



### Agent Marketing & Relationship Management



* Serve as the primary marketing point of contact for agents.

* Build relationships through calls, meetings, trainings, events, and proactive outreach.

* Proactively reach out to agents instead of waiting for marketing requests.

* Understand each agent’s business, goals, challenges, market, budget, and marketing activity.

* Conduct marketing consultations, brand audits, website reviews, and strategy sessions.

* Identify gaps in branding, websites, social media, databases, content, and follow-up systems.

* Recommend practical marketing priorities based on each agent’s goals and resources.

* Help agents improve their personal brand, content, email marketing, websites, social media, and database marketing.

* Follow up after consultations and help agents take action.

* Share recurring agent feedback and needs with leadership.



### Marketing Services Sales & Growth



* Lead the growth strategy for the Marketing Services Division.

* Understand all available services, pricing, deliverables, timelines, and processes.

* Introduce agents to marketing services through consultations, email, trainings, webinars, events, and direct outreach.

* Conduct discovery calls to understand agent needs.

* Recommend services based on the agent’s goals, budget, and marketing needs.

* Clearly explain services, pricing, timelines, responsibilities, and expectations.

* Confidently ask for the business when there is a strong fit.

* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales process.

* Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, proposals, enrollments, active clients, renewals, and cancellations.

* Identify upsell and expansion opportunities with existing clients.

* Track leads, conversions, revenue, retention, and cancellations.



### Client Onboarding



* Own the onboarding experience for new marketing services clients.

* Welcome new clients and explain next steps.

* Confirm agreements, payments, services, timelines, responsibilities, and communication expectations.

* Collect required information, files, brand assets, and account access.

* Set up projects, tasks, deadlines, owners, and workflows in 
.

* Coordinate kickoff meetings and handoffs to the fulfillment team.

* Monitor the first stages of service delivery.

* Check in with clients during their first 30 days.

* Address onboarding concerns and coordinate solutions.

* Maintain organized client records and improve onboarding systems when needed.



### New Agent Marketing Onboarding



* Participate in the onboarding of newly affiliated agents.

* Introduce agents to available marketing tools, resources, trainings, templates, and support.

* Explain what is included with the brokerage and what is available separately through marketing services.

* Conduct an initial marketing assessment for each new agent.

* Identify the top marketing priorities they should focus on first.

* Coordinate agent bios, headshots, profiles, websites, welcome campaigns, and announcements when needed.

* Follow up after onboarding to encourage adoption and identify additional needs.



### Content, Messaging & Storytelling



* Lead messaging and content strategy for major company initiatives.

* Develop copy and messaging for recruiting, training, agent recognition, culture, announcements, and marketing services.

* Turn leadership ideas into campaigns, emails, scripts, website copy, presentations, and marketing briefs.

* Develop agent stories, success stories, and recognition content.

* Maintain a consistent, clear, personal, and human brand voice.



### Training & Event Marketing



* Lead marketing for trainings, webinars, workshops, meetings, and company events.

* Manage the training and event marketing calendar.

* Develop promotional messaging, registration campaigns, reminders, and follow-up communication.

* Coordinate graphics, presentations, landing pages, emails, social posts, and other event materials.

* Track registrations, attendance, participation, and feedback.



### Websites & Digital Platforms



* Oversee website strategy, structure, messaging, and content.

* Coordinate website updates, landing pages, agent pages, recruiting pages, and service pages.

* Maintain accurate information about services, pricing, processes, testimonials, FAQs, and calls to action.

* Improve website user experience and lead-generation opportunities.

* Coordinate advanced development or integrations with appropriate specialists.

* Ensure website leads are captured, tracked, and followed up.



### Community, YouTube & Agent Communication



* Manage the strategy and organization of the Company’s online agent community.

* Determine which trainings, resources, announcements, stories, and updates should be shared.

* Encourage agent participation through useful content and personal outreach.

* Oversee the Company’s YouTube content strategy.

* Coordinate video editing, thumbnails, uploads, titles, descriptions, and publishing with the production team.

* Coordinate messaging across email, community platforms, social media, meetings, and other channels.



### Marketing Operations & Project Management



* Build and manage marketing workflows in 
.

* Coordinate marketing projects from request through completion.

* Ensure every project has a clear owner, deadline, purpose, status, and next step.

* Coordinate designers, editors, website specialists, virtual assistants, contractors, and vendors.

* Manage revisions, approvals, missing information, and project communication.

* Build repeatable systems for campaigns, onboarding, trainings, websites, and recurring marketing activities.

* Document processes so work can be delegated and scaled.

* Monitor team capacity and identify bottlenecks.

* Maintain quality standards without becoming the main production person.



### Agent Engagement & Retention



* Create initiatives that help agents feel recognized, supported, and connected.

* Develop welcome campaigns, milestone recognition, anniversaries, success stories, and community highlights.

* Identify disengaged agents and coordinate thoughtful outreach.

* Gather feedback about marketing support, trainings, communication, and services.

* Recommend improvements that increase agent satisfaction, participation, productivity, and retention.



## Role Boundaries



The Head of Marketing & Agent Growth is responsible for strategy, relationships, sales, onboarding, coordination, and quality — not being the Company’s primary production person.



### This Role Owns



* Marketing strategy and brand direction.

* Agent marketing relationships and consultations.

* Agent outreach and marketing assessments.

* Marketing services discovery and sales conversations.

* Sales pipeline management and growth.

* Client onboarding.

* New-agent marketing onboarding.

* Campaign planning and creative direction.

* Copywriting and messaging.

* Training and event marketing.

* Website strategy and messaging.

* Marketing systems and workflows.

* Project coordination and team direction.

* Quality control and reporting.



### This Role May Coordinate but Does Not Need to Personally Execute



* High-volume graphic design.

* Logo design.

* Daily Canva production.

* Video editing and animation.

* Advanced website development.

* Daily social media posting.

* Photography and videography.

* Large-scale content repurposing.

* Routine client fulfillment.

* Technical integrations.

* Repetitive administrative production.



The goal is to hire a marketing and growth leader — not a production coordinator handling every flyer, website edit, or social media request.



## Required Qualifications



* 5+ years of experience in marketing, account management, business development, consultative sales, real estate, or a related field.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Experience developing marketing strategies, campaigns, messaging, and content.

* Strong relationship-building and client-facing experience.

* Experience conducting discovery calls, consultations, assessments, or sales conversations.

* Comfortable proactively reaching out to agents and asking for the business when appropriate.

* Strong project management and organizational skills.

* Experience managing multiple projects, clients, stakeholders, team members, or contractors.

* Strong copywriting, storytelling, editing, and messaging skills.

* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

* Ability to work independently and follow through without constant supervision.

* Comfortable balancing relationship-building with revenue and performance expectations.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving remote environment.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in real estate, a brokerage, real estate team, marketing agency, coaching company, or membership organization.

* Knowledge of real estate agent marketing, personal branding, recruiting, retention, database marketing, and lead generation.

* Experience selling marketing, branding, website, consulting, or content services.

* Experience onboarding clients into recurring service packages.

* Familiarity with Lofty, Squarespace, 
, Circle, Canva, CRM systems, email marketing platforms, and social media tools.

* Experience managing virtual assistants, designers, developers, editors, contractors, or creative teams.

* Basic website management experience.

* Experience tracking marketing, sales, engagement, retention, and revenue metrics.

* Experience using AI for research, writing, planning, content development, analysis, or workflow improvement.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is strategic, proactive, relationship-driven, and commercially aware.



They can develop a company-wide marketing strategy while also speaking directly with an individual agent about their business and marketing needs.



They proactively reach out, identify opportunities, recommend solutions, follow up, and ensure commitments are completed.



They are comfortable conducting consultations, recommending services, asking for the sale, onboarding clients, and coordinating a fulfillment team.



They understand that marketing is not simply creating graphics or posting content. Marketing should strengthen relationships, communicate value, generate opportunities, and support measurable business outcomes.



## Key Performance Measures



* Agent conversations and marketing consultations.

* Consultation follow-up completion.

* New-agent marketing onboarding completion.

* Agent satisfaction and engagement.

* Marketing services discovery calls and proposals.

* Discovery-to-enrollment conversion rate.

* New recurring and one-time revenue.

* Active clients, retention, renewals, and cancellations.

* Client onboarding completion and first-30-day experience.

* Marketing campaign performance.

* Training registrations and attendance.

* Email, website, and community engagement.

* On-time project completion.

* Quality and organization of marketing workflows.

* Development of repeatable marketing systems.



## First 90 Days



### First 30 Days — Learn & Audit



* Learn the Company’s business model, brand, agents, systems, services, and culture.

* Meet with leadership, operations, recruiting, brokerage, marketing team members, and agents.

* Review current websites, campaigns, emails, social media, community platforms, YouTube, and marketing workflows.

* Learn all marketing services, pricing, processes, and fulfillment standards.

* Review the sales pipeline, active clients, onboarding process, and fulfillment workflows.

* Identify immediate marketing, sales, onboarding, communication, and operational gaps.

* Establish baseline performance metrics.



### Days 31–60 — Build the Foundation



* Establish a consistent agent outreach and consultation process.

* Create a repeatable marketing audit and recommendation process.

* Improve the marketing services sales pipeline and tracking system.

* Document client onboarding and handoff processes.

* Establish marketing, content, training, and communication calendars.

* Improve how marketing resources and services are introduced to agents.

* Begin consistent proactive agent outreach.

* Identify priority campaigns for recruiting, retention, training, culture, and revenue growth.



### Days 61–90 — Launch & Improve



* Present and execute a prioritized quarterly marketing plan.

* Launch priority marketing and growth campaigns.

* Begin reporting marketing, sales, agent engagement, and revenue metrics.

* Recommend improvements to services, positioning, onboarding, fulfillment, and client experience.

* Establish a consistent reporting process.

* Clarify responsibilities across strategy, sales, onboarding, project management, and production.

* Identify additional staffing, contractor, system, or training needs.

* Provide leadership with a clear assessment of what is working, what needs improvement, and recommended next steps.

title: Shopify Designer & Developer — Full Site Re-Skin (3-Week Fixed Price)

Revisions are unlimited within each milestone as long as feedback comes back in one consolidated round. Nothing goes live until the full theme is approved.

title: E-Commerce Customer Support Operator
description:
We are a growing e-commerce support provider. We place trained Filipino operators inside US e-commerce brands. We are hiring CS Operators.



This is not a general VA role. You will own one brand's customer inbox and write in that brand's voice, using the systems and standards we certify you on.



### What you will do



You handle the front line of a US brand's customer inbox.



That means tickets across
 and chat, "where is my order" questions with live carrier lookups, returns and exchanges processed to the brand's SOP, and responses to product reviews and Trustpilot.



You also triage escalations. Anything involving refunds, chargebacks or disputes gets routed, not handled. CS Operators carry no money-movement authority. That boundary protects you as much as it protects the client.



You keep a daily ticket log and track your own CSAT.



### Who this is for



You have at least 12 months handling a real online store's customer inbox. Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Lazada, Shopee, WooCommerce, eBay, Etsy or BigCommerce all count.



You have worked inside a ticketing or seller messaging platform. Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Help Scout, Re:amaze, Intercom, Tidio, or a marketplace message center.



You write English that needs no editing. You can sound warm and casual for one brand and precise and formal for another, on the same set of facts.



You can handle tickets around 80+ per day.



Shopify admin experience is a strong plus. It is not required if the rest of your profile is strong.



### The hours, stated plainly



Our current clients are US brands, so most shifts follow US business hours. Depending on which client you are placed with, your shift will fall somewhere in this range:



- US Eastern client: 9:00pm to 6:00am PHT

- US Central client: 10:00pm to 7:00am PHT

- US Pacific client: 12:00am to 9:00am PHT



You must be available to work in any time zone, depending on where we assign you. We may place you with a client outside the US. For US clients, your shift also moves by one hour twice a year when the US changes clocks.



We ask for your preferred schedule in the application. We will consider it, but your final shift depends on the client you are assigned to.



We are telling you this before you apply because we would rather you d
 now than in month two. If a shift that changes with the client does not fit your life, this role will not fit either.



### How you get in



Four steps. Application, a short skills assessment, a written and video assessment, then a live interview.



If you pass, you are offered a seat in the CS Certification Bootcamp.



### About the Bootcamp



Three days, paid at $2.50/hr, eight hours a day.



Before Day 1 you complete a short self-paced pre-work module, about 3 hours, covering Shopify admin and helpdesk basics. Finishing it is a condition of keeping your seat.



During Bootcamp you are trained on brand voice, our tag taxonomy and macro library, Shopify order admin, returns and exchanges, de-escalation, and escalation routing.



It ends with a 50-ticket simulation. You need a 90% QA score to certify.



Be clear on this: **a Bootcamp seat is not a job offer.** Certification is what earns deployment. We pay you for the three days either way, and we tell you your score honestly.



### Pay and the path forward



Starting rate is $3.00/hr to start, with a defined progression path



That is a starting number, and it is attached to a path. Certified operators move up:



**CS Operator → Senior CS Operator → CS Resolution Specialist**



Each tier carries a higher rate and more authority. The Resolution Specialist tier holds money authority: refunds, chargebacks and disputes.



Movement is based on certification and QA performance, not on how long you have been here. We fill senior roles from our own bench first, which is why we care so much about who we let into Bootcamp.



You also get: paid Bootcamp days, a certification that belongs to you, written SOPs and a Brand Bible for every client, a named escalation path so you are never guessing alone, and a QA scorecard so you always know where you stand.



### What we need from you



- A computer at i5, Ryzen 5, M1 or better, with 8GB RAM

- Internet at 20 Mbps down and 10 Mbps up, wired or stable fiber

- A named backup internet connection

- Backup power covering at least 30 minutes

- A quiet, dedicated workspace and a headset

- Availability for the pre-work and all three Bootcamp days

- Availability to work any time zone, based on client assignment

- Willingness to give one reference from a past CS supervisor or client



### To apply



Answer the questions below. Please answer them yourself, in your own words. We read every one, and specific answers move forward.



Please put your resume link and a loom video introduction on top of the cover letter so we can easily see and to check if you read the whole job listing.



1. Which online store(s) have you handled customer messages for? For each one, tell us the platform (Shopify, Amazon, Lazada, Shopee or other), the ticketing or messaging tool you used (if you only used
 or WhatsApp, say so), how many months you worked on it, and about how many tickets you handled in a normal day.

2. **Tell me about one specific customer you helped that you still remember. What did they want, what did you do, and how did it end?** (3 to 5 sentences)

3. A customer
s: "This is the third time I'm asking. Where is my order?" You check and the tracking has not moved in 6 days. Write the reply you would send.

4. Have you worked overnight or irregular hours before (graveyard, rotating or weekend shifts)? If yes, for how long and what were the hours? If no, say no.

5. Describe your computer (processor, RAM), your internet speed, your backup internet, and your backup power.

6. What is your current work situation, and when could you start a 3-day Bootcamp?

7. What shift would you prefer, and what hours are you available? This is a preference we will consider. Your final shift depends on the client we assign you to, and you need to be able to work in any time zone.
salary: $3 per hour to start, with progression

title: SEO Manager – Full Time
description:
🏢 Company: Get Me Links

💵 Monthly Fee: $1,000/$1,200 per month, depending on experience, plus performance bonuses

🌍 Location: Fully remote

🕓 Hours: Full-time (flexible, but overlap with 1pm–10pm PH time required)



🎁 What You Get

Your monthly rate is only half the package. You'll also get:

  4 weeks of paid time off

  Performance bonuses tied to results

  A fully remote role: work from wherever you do your best work

  A full tool stack, with no fighting for the software you need

  A team ready to run the services you design, and the training to make that happen

  Close work with our Director of Service Operations

  A flexible schedule, no time tracking



💼 What You'll Be Doing

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building new services to grow beyond what we offer today. This is not a client SEO role: you won't run campaigns for individual clients. You'll own our off-page SEO operations and build the ones that don't exist yet, then keep them running well. You'll design new services, prove they work, turn them into processes a team can run, and maintain their quality over time. Link building is your core strength, and you bring a full understanding of SEO, so you can help build services across the whole picture.



Some examples of what we want to build:

  New types of link building beyond what we offer today

  Our own sites for link placement

  Buying expired and auction domains, then restoring them

  Link exchange programs run at scale



Your day-to-day:

  Build new services: find and design new SEO services we can sell and deliver

  Expand our offer: turn opportunities in Local SEO, GEO, AI visibility, listicles and Digital PR into services we can deliver at scale

  Grow the publisher network: build strong publisher relationships, negotiate prices, and run outreach at scale

  Protect link quality: set vetting standards that go beyond DR and traffic, and keep risky or spammy sites out of our network

  Shape link strategy: define best practice for anchor text mix, link velocity, relevance and target page selection

  Audit and analyze: run backlink audits and competitor link gap analysis to find new opportunities

  Apply the full SEO picture: work with our Director of Service Operations to bring on-page and technical knowledge (site speed, keyword targeting, site health) into how we vet sites and shape new services

  Set content standards: define briefs and quality bars for placement content, including how to spot low-quality AI content

  Systemize: turn each service into a repeatable process with SOPs and quality checks

  Train the people who run those services

  Maintain: monitor quality and results, fix what breaks, and update processes as SEO changes

  Measure: track links that stay live and get indexed, how long they last, and their impact on rankings and AI visibility

  Bring the outside in: share new SEO knowledge so the whole team grows past what we already know



🧬 Who You Are

An SEO manager who lives and breathes link building.

You look at a publisher site and immediately see the spam signals, the link farm footprints, or the traffic that isn't real, and you can explain why. You're savvy on how to get links that actually help: velocity, relevance, anchor text and the right tools. You also understand the full spectrum of SEO, so you know a slow site or poor keyword targeting can undermine a great link. You don't just run a playbook, you build one: you take a new idea, test it, prove it works, and turn it into a process a team can follow. You have strong opinions on SEO and can defend them, and you have the discipline to work within agreed standards once a decision is made. You keep up with algorithm changes because you want to.



✅ Requirements

  Deep, hands-on SEO experience, with real strength in off-page and link building

  A proven record of publisher outreach and relationship building at scale

  A sharp eye for link quality and risk: spam signals, link farms, Google spam policies, toxic links, disavow and penalty recovery

  Solid working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO (site speed, keyword targeting, site health), enough to judge site    quality and help shape new services

  Working knowledge across the wider SEO landscape: guest posts, niche edits and brand mentions, listicles, GEO, AI visibility,     Digital PR, Local SEO and backlink audits

  Experience with domain auctions, expired domain vetting and site restoration

  Hands-on skill with Ahrefs and Semrush, plus outreach tools such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream or Hunter

  Proof that you have built a service or process from scratch and kept it running well over time

  Experience leading or training a team

  Reliable internet and availability for the required overlap hours



🔥 Bonus Points If You…

Have an agency or link-selling background

Have experience with domain marketplaces and expired domain tools

Are comfortable with numbers: cost per link, margins and capacity planning



🎯 Your First 90 Days

In your first 90 days, you will:

  Learn our current services, publisher network and quality standards

  Audit our off-page processes and present your top improvement opportunities

  Propose at least one new service with a clear plan, cost model and SOP

  Launch that service as a pilot, with a team trained to run it



📝 How We'll Choose

We want to see the work, not just talk about it, so every applicant goes through the same steps:

1. Application + portfolio. For two or three services, processes or link projects you built, tell us what you made and what your role was, how it performed (links live, indexed, retention, rankings, margins), and what you learned and would do differently.

2. First interview with MJ, our Head of Operations. A conversation about your experience, how you vet link quality, your grasp of on-page and technical SEO basics, and how you turn an idea into a process a team can run.

3. Final interview with our CEO and COO. A deeper conversation on how you would build and pilot a new service, and how you work within agreed standards.

Please
 the following to 
 with the subject: "SEO Manager – I'm [Your Name] and I Build SEO Services That Scale"

Include:

   1. Your resume with two professional references

title: Facebook Ads Direct Response Video Editor
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

$15 per completed minute of video



The more completed video work you produce, the more you can earn.



BONUS SCHEME FOR WINNING ADS



On top of the normal per-minute pay, there are additional bonuses for ads you create that become winning ads.



$200 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending over $200 per day at a 1.8 ROAS or above = $200 bonus



$1,000 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending $1,000 per day at a 2.0 ROAS or above = $1,000 bonus



These bonuses are paid on top of your normal per-minute video compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



NEURAL

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job description

We're looking for a Creative Strategist to shape how our health & pharmaceutical brands communicate across both digital & offline channels. You'll craft effective strategies that translate scientific credibility into compelling storytelling & creative assets - helping us engage our diverse audience as we expand our presence regionally. 



The Creative Strategist will be the visionary link between our brand identity, compelling content creation & drive measurable performance across all key channels. This role is responsible for developing & testing high-impact creative strategies as well as producing content assets (visual, video, copy) internally, specifically designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates, lower Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee & Lazada stores via social media as well as paid advertising platforms.



You'll work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the new channels of the business. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy

- Platform & Channel Strategy: Craft tailored creative strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific best practices & formats that align with brand goals & regulatory requirements in each market (e.g., Meta carousel ads, vertical video for TikTok/Reels, static product carousels for Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banner ads).

- Hypothesis Generation & A/B Testing: Develop robust creative testing matrices, formulate clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, calls-to-action, visual styles, copy length) that drive measurable improvements in Click-Through Rate (CTR) & Conversion Rate (CVR).

- Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion).

- Competitive Analysis: Continuously keep up to date with competitors & industry trends, identifying new & successful creative formats, hooks & messaging to finetune our strategy.

In-House Content Production & Execution 

- Performance Creative Development: Lead the end-to-end creative concept development & production for all organic & paid media campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube, etc.) that align with brand & campaign goals, focusing on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing required for performance marketing.

- Hands-on Asset Creation: Directly produce & edit native social content & performance ads using existing assets, stock libraries & internal resources. This includes:

i. Plan platform-specific content calendars: Cover educational, promotional & corporate communications

ii. Static/Image Editing: Adapt product photography, create ad variations & design simple graphics & banner ads

iii. Video Editing: Fast-paced assembly, cutting, adding text overlays, music & effects for short-form, vertical video (UGC-style, product demos, testimonials)

- Copywriting: Develop high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & social media captions that align with the creative strategy & brand voice, with a focus on clear value propositions & strong CTAs.

- Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across relevant channels (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada store fronts & advertising platforms).

- Testing & Optimization: apply insights & analytics to refine & optimize content effectiveness across platforms.

Performance & Reporting

- Data-Driven Insights: Work closely with the Marketing Manager to analyze creative performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving results (or failing) across Shopify, Shopee & Lazada traffic.

- Iteration & Optimization: 

i. Develop, adapt or review content & formats to improve engagement & performance

ii. Use performance data (ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR) to rapidly iterate on existing creative assets & inform future strategy, ensuring a continuous cycle of improvement & optimization

Storefront Integration: Integrate winning creative messages & visuals onto the respective e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a cohesive customer journey.

Multi-Channel Storytelling

- Content cohesion: Ensure content is aligned where possible across digital & print media, including LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube, e-commerce platforms, brochures & trade materials.

- Tailor content: To achieve relevance & effectiveness across different stages of the audience journey — from brand awareness & education to conversion.

- Storytelling & visual consistency: To strengthen brand trust & recognition.

Compliance & Brand Integrity

- Uphold regulatory & ethical communication standards across all marketing activities.

- Ensure all content complies with regulatory guidelines & marketing requirements in each country we operate in, including product claims, advertising language & digital promotions.

- Maintain brand credibility by ensuring all communications are factual & aligned with company values.

- Collaborate with internal teams to review materials for accuracy, effectiveness & compliance before publication.



Requirements:

- 3–5 years of experience in creative strategy, content creation, social media, or brand marketing — ideally in health supplements, healthcare or wellness.

- Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta (FB/IG), LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Google, Generative AI).

- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools.

- Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills — adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals.

- Excellent communication, project management & cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)
